taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_max_m.note: FEIS's rusty menziesia review (Habeck 1992, as Menziesia ferruginea, read 2026-10-16): "Rusty menziesia is an erect, deciduous shrub 3.3 to 6.6 feet (1-2 m) tall".

traits.leaf_habit.note: FEIS's rusty menziesia review (Habeck 1992, as Menziesia ferruginea, read 2026-10-16): "an erect, deciduous shrub".

traits.leaf_length_m.note: FEIS's rusty menziesia review (Habeck 1992, as Menziesia ferruginea, read 2026-10-16): "Ovate-elliptic to elliptic-obovate leaves are 1.5 to 2.5 inches (4-6 cm) long".

traits.leaf_shape.note: FEIS's rusty menziesia review (Habeck 1992, as Menziesia ferruginea, read 2026-10-16): "Ovate-elliptic to elliptic-obovate leaves".

traits.inflorescence.note: A model estimate (confidence high), FEIS (Habeck 1992) does not describe the flowers.

traits.fruit_type.note: FEIS's rusty menziesia review (Habeck 1992, as Menziesia ferruginea, read 2026-10-16): "The fruits are oval capsules".

traits.fruit_size_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high), FEIS's "0.20 to 0.28 inch (5-7 mm)" (Habeck 1992) is ambiguous between capsule and seed; the model's 5-8 mm is used.

traits.flowering_months.note: FEIS's rusty menziesia review (Habeck 1992, as Menziesia ferruginea, read 2026-10-16): "Rusty menziesia flowers from late May through July".

traits.fruiting_months.note: FEIS's rusty menziesia review (Habeck 1992, as Menziesia ferruginea, read 2026-10-16): "capsules mature in July and August".

generator.params.note: Red huckleberry's values, changed by hand for rusty menziesia: an erect shrub of 1-2 m with leaves clustered toward the twig tips and nodding urn-shaped flowers in small terminal clusters (FEIS, Habeck 1992). Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 1.5 m at 12 years in the open, the middle of FEIS's 1-2 m (Habeck 1992). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye: pale blue-green, sticky leaves; salmon-coloured nodding urns (the species-facts estimate gives pink); scaly bark on older branches (FEIS: "scaly bark on older branches").

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2905087), as no source read gives it.

traits.rosette.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2905087), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2905087), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_margin.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2905087), as no source read gives it.
